routeInsteadTo.request: submit an inquiry for my daughter
routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent. The public inquiry form only.
routeInsteadTo.note: A family fills the form themselves at the public address. Nothing in this layer submits on their behalf, because the submission stamps source Online Form (BR-1) and that stamp would then be false.

request.text: ye family ne phone kiya tha, inquiry daal do
request.gloss: this family phoned, put the enquiry in

routeInsteadTo.note: A staff member recording an enquiry taken by phone or in person is a different use case with a different source stamp. That one is planned.

request.gloss: where do I get the admission form?

routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent. UC-02-04, reached only by invite.
routeInsteadTo.note: There is no public address for the admission form (BR-4). It is opened by the single-use invite issued at approval.

request.text: mera bacha pehle yahan parhta tha

routeInsteadTo.goesTo: Still the public form, with Re-admission ticked — UC-02-09
routeInsteadTo.note: Re-admission starts as an ordinary inquiry with the box ticked (BR-5). The first planned act on it is confirming the match.

routeInsteadTo.request: check whether we already have this child on file
routeInsteadTo.note: The duplicate check is the reviewer's act, not the family's.
